title: Cloud installs keep the hand-off start-up hooks, or say why not
why: Finding, Oct 27 23:11 CDT (an audit session's report, relayed in cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh23uGo4eqsUrqqbGKYMctN3n): install.sh near line 632 makes a cloud install replace every start-up hook with the refresh hook, so cloud sessions lose the hand-off hooks.
note: Debt. Unknown whether that is intended; no record says. Next cloud lane: read install.sh's cloud branch and the decision that added it; if not intended, keep the hand-off hooks beside the refresh hook, red first on a cloud install whose settings lack them; if intended, write the reason in the decision. Ties to c54 part 3 (install claude-settings in cloud containers). Needs no answer. Port: no; install.sh lives here. Placed ahead of c82 (triage, Oct 28): every cloud session may lose its hand-off.
